readout_other: Von Frey filaments; hot plate test; common peroneal nerve sensory nerve action potential latency and amplitude; H&E and FluoroJade-B staining of L5 DRG
direction_notes: External liFUS at the L5 DRG raised mechanical and thermal nociceptive thresholds in CPNI rats at 24 h and transiently shortened SNAP latency (up to about 30 min) in both CPNI and sham-CPNI rats, with no change in SNAP amplitude.
safety_notes: H&E and FluoroJade staining of L5 DRG 24 h after liFUS showed no pyknosis, oedema or significant neuronal degeneration.

device.model: TheraVision ultrasound system and ultrasonic therapy transducer probe

timing.protocol_description: liFUS was administered at 8 W for 3 min with 11 MHz pulsed at 38 Hz with a period of 90 ns, and a pulse width of 13 ms. SNAP recordings occurred concurrently with liFUS or sham treatment; behavioural testing repeated 24 h later.

source_quotes.n_subjects: (B) The change in post-surgical VFF score 24 h after liFUS treatment shown for the four cohorts (CPNI liFUS $n = 8 ;$ CPNI shamliFUS $n = 6 ;$ sham CPNI liFUS $n = 5 ;$ sham CPNI shamliFUS $n = 4 )$ .
